title: VIXEN configure requires a generated Undertow text-shader provider but cannot provision or derive one
body: The documented VIXEN configure path derived the sibling Undertow checkout, which lacked transpiled/textshader/Text.g.h and text.g.glsl. I had to manually set UNDERTOW_ROOT to a paired generated provider worktree and disable VIXEN_AUTO_DERIVE_UNDERTOW_ROOT before configure could proceed. Consolidate provider generation/selection so a fresh VIXEN lane obtains the required read-only generated interface without manual cross-worktree setup.
